impact.entryPoint: A workspace-local Android environment script and owner-readable sequential release progress; app navigation remains governed by current mobile source.
impact.dataWrite: Local downloaded SDK tools, Gradle output, sanitized validation logs and evidence; no customer rows, Auth users or remote configuration changes.
impact.backendContract: Read current blocked ledger and clean-QA candidate; public project metadata only. No API/schema change or retarget; synthetic replay must be isolated from outbound services before execution.
impact.adminVisibility: Private owner progress records automated results, cloud target status and independent unrun gates; no public Help or Admin content publication.
impact.privacySafety: Never print environment values, credentials or private device/account captures. Preserve existing SDK licenses and signing identities; production secrets remain in protected provider/CI tooling.
impact.observability: Capture command, exit code, current source SHA, relevant dirty input hashes, official download checksum, tool versions and native warning evidence. This is preparation evidence, not a release manifest or approval.
impact.rollback: Use task-local tools/environment and revert only this script/report if needed. Preserve old APK/manifest before a local build. Old QA stays available; do not reset checkout, uninstall device app or rewrite database history.
impact.surfacesIntentionallyUntouched: Runtime UI, shared prompts, migrations, private user data, product content, payments and cloud publication.
impact.agentHandoff: Root owns this preparation scope; final gates require authenticated CI/EAS, exact backend mapping, protected signing and manager device acceptance on the produced candidate.

securityReview.authzRls: No authorization change; clean QA still needs ordinary A/B/revoked actor acceptance and explicit object/grant inventory before cloud execution.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Use metadata, fictional fixtures and sanitized logs only; no business row dumps or live user copies.
securityReview.secretsLogging: Do not output keystore secrets, environment dumps, provider tokens or raw private payloads; query authentication status only.
securityReview.externalInput: Download HTTPS Google archive, verify published SHA-256 before extraction/execution, and keep generated tools under an explicitly verified workspace path.
securityReview.dependencies: Preserve application lockfile/dependency versions. Pin Android tool archive and process-local JDK/SDK paths; diagnostic discovery of effective AGP is required before considering an app dependency change.
securityReview.migrationRelease: No cloud SQL, retarget, production provisioning or credential mutation in preparation. Source freeze and signed build depend on reviewed dirty inputs and configured protected release identity.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop dependent release execution on missing target mapping, blocked ledger, authentication/signing access, unrehearsed schema, unmatched hashes or required production secrets in the agent session. Continue independent local checks.

workingTreeReview.note: Preserve existing unrelated dirty mobile/auth, web/admin, skills and release evidence work. Scope-specific paths are inventoried before preflight; local validation does not certify a clean candidate.
